name: Paper Stack vs Two Taps
why_it_works: Dreaded processes (paperwork, intake, appointments) stop people from even starting. Showing the old pile next to the new few-tap version shrinks the perceived effort, and lower effort is what turns 'someday' into 'today'.

hook.pattern: Open on a physical symbol of the old hassle next to the new shortcut, then count the steps.
examples: This is what {{process}} used to take. This is now.
The old way: {{old_steps}}. Our way: count the taps.
If {{process}} scares you, you're picturing the old way.

variables.name: old_steps
variables.description: The old way in a few words
variables.example: a folder of printouts and three office visits

variables.name: new_steps
variables.description: Your way in a few words
variables.example: upload from your phone, one 20-minute call

variables.name: human_touch
variables.description: The person who still helps, to show it's not just an app

variables.name: offer
variables.example: Start your pre-approval from your phone

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photo of a tall teetering stack of paper forms and folders next to a single smartphone on a clean desk, dramatic side light, the stack casting a long shadow over the phone
Vertical photo of a tired person at a kitchen table buried in paper forms, late evening lamp light, coffee mug, sticky notes everywhere, face partly hidden
Vertical close-up of a thumb tapping through a simple clean upload flow on a phone screen with generic interface and {{brand}} colors, couch in soft daylight in the background, smooth natural motion
Vertical portrait of a friendly {{brand}} professional on a phone call at a bright office desk, genuine smile, natural window light

craft.notes: The opening stack has to look physically heavy so the phone looks light. Always follow the tech beat with a human beat: in high-trust services people fear being left alone with an app more than they fear paperwork.

do_not: Promise speed you can't deliver every time (approval times, case timelines)
Show a real application, client file or personal data on screen
Imply the app replaces professional advice
compliance: Mortgage: no guarantees of approval, rates or closing times; show the company NMLS number and Equal Housing Opportunity logo
Law firms: no guaranteed outcomes; include the attorney advertising label and responsible attorney where your state bar requires
Dental: describe digital tools accurately and make no outcome promises
Real estate and insurance: show license name and number as your state requires; insurance coverage and pricing vary by policy
